title: Alex Eala holds off lucky loser Emerson Jones at Hong Kong Open
summary: LIVE: Alex Eala vs Emerson Jones – Hong Kong Open Round of 32 MANILA, Philippines–Alex Eala staved off a scare from lucky loser Emerson Jones, 6-4, 6-3, to advance to the Hong Kong Open round of 16…

blocks.text: LIVE: Alex Eala vs Emerson Jones – Hong Kong Open Round of 32 MANILA, Philippines–Alex Eala staved off a scare from lucky loser Emerson Jones, 6-4, 6-3, to advance to the Hong Kong Open round of 16 on Tuesday night. Eala was again buoyed by a big Filipino crowd at Center Court and she raced to big leads early in both sets before overcoming Jones’ comeback bids. “Super happy to be here in Hong Kong, super happy with the performance,” said Eala.
